title: Vivex biograft based on recovered metal regrows bone

tellings.quote: They were creating what's called a viograph which was uh it was based on metal the metal that they recovered

plain: In the 2010s, according to Chris Bledsoe, a company called Vivex made a bone-regrowing biograft that he says was "based on metal the metal that they recovered," meaning material from a crashed UFO. Bledsoe is a man who says he has had repeated UFO encounters. He tells Michels this from his own involvement and names Timothy Taylor in connection with it. If true, crash debris would already have led to a medical product.
